<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Ordinary Turtle 25</title>
<style>
/* Ordinary Turtle 25 by Yaseen549 — https://uiverse.io/Yaseen549/ordinary-turtle-25 */
.button {
  color: #8707ff;
  border: 2px solid #8707ff;
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 10px 25px;
  background: transparent;
}

.button:hover {
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 15px #8707ff inset;
}

.button:active {
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 20px #8707ff inset;
}
</style>
</head>

</button>
